_meta.title: Technology | Gausin International Engineers Pvt. Ltd.
hero.desc.0: From process simulation to smart factory automation - we leverage cutting-edge tools and technologies to design, fabricate, and deliver superior industrial engineering solutions.
sec.desc.0: We use industry-leading engineering software to design, simulate, and validate every process system before a single component is fabricated.
sec.desc.1: Our manufacturing facility is equipped with advanced fabrication technology to produce high-precision industrial equipment meeting international quality standards.
sec.desc.2: A structured, quality-driven fabrication process ensures every piece of equipment meets specification before it leaves our workshop.
p.0: From process simulation to smart factory automation - we leverage cutting-edge tools and technologies to design, fabricate, and deliver superior industrial engineering solutions.
p.1: Computer-numerical-control plasma and laser cutting for precise cutting of plates, pipes, and profiles - achieving tolerances of +/-0.1mm for critical components.
p.2: Certified welders using TIG, MIG, and Submerged Arc Welding processes for high-quality, radiographically tested welds on all pressure parts and hygienic vessels.
p.3: Specialized tube rolling machines for uniform heat exchanger tube expansion, ensuring leak-proof tube-to-tubesheet joints across hundreds of tubes.
p.4: Electropolishing, mechanical polishing, and passivation to achieve Ra <= 0.4 um mirror finish on dairy and pharmaceutical contact surfaces.
p.5: Radiographic testing (RT), ultrasonic testing (UT), dye penetrant (PT), magnetic particle (MT), and hydrostatic pressure testing - all in-house.
p.6: We integrate PLC/SCADA automation and IoT-enabled monitoring platforms into all our plant solutions - enabling real-time control, data-driven decisions, and remote plant management.
p.7: See how our technology-driven engineering approach can optimize your industrial processes, reduce costs, and improve plant performance.
glass.desc.0: Siemens, Allen-Bradley, Mitsubishi PLC programming for precise process automation and safety interlocks.
glass.desc.1: Custom SCADA interfaces with real-time process monitoring, alarm management, and recipe control.
glass.desc.2: Cloud-based plant monitoring with mobile alerts, remote diagnostics, and predictive maintenance analytics.
glass.desc.3: Production reports, batch records, energy consumption tracking, and OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) dashboards.
tool.desc.0: Industry-standard CAD platform for producing precise engineering drawings, 3D models, P&IDs, plant layouts, and fabrication detail drawings.
tool.desc.1: Advanced chemical process simulation software used for mass & energy balance calculations, equipment sizing, thermodynamic modeling, and process optimization.
tool.desc.2: Industry-standard heat transfer research software for rigorous thermal design, rating, and simulation of shell & tube, plate, and other heat exchanger types with real fluid properties.
tool.desc.3: Comprehensive project planning, scheduling, resource allocation, and progress tracking tool ensuring on-time delivery with full visibility into project milestones and critical path.
fab.desc.0: Raw materials procured from approved vendors with full material test reports (MTR), heat numbers, and certifications.
fab.desc.1: CNC plasma/laser cutting, plate rolling, bending, and forming to precise dimensions per approved drawings.
fab.desc.2: Certified welders perform TIG/MIG/SAW welding with pre-weld and post-weld heat treatment (PWHT) where required.
fab.desc.3: Radiographic (RT), ultrasonic (UT), dye penetrant (PT), and magnetic particle (MT) inspection of critical welds.
fab.desc.4: Mechanical polishing, electropolishing, passivation, sand/shot blasting, and painting as per specification.
fab.desc.5: Hydrostatic pressure test at 1.5x design pressure to verify structural integrity and absence of leaks.
fab.desc.6: Dimensional inspection, completeness check, and final quality sign-off - with option for third-party/client inspection.
fab.desc.7: Proper preservation, packing, marking, and secure transportation with all documentation and QA records.
